summary: Iteration 2: validated new Apple/Emergent-Google session/Razorpay endpoints and unified current_user (JWT + session_token). Backend: 30/30 pytest passed including 9 new tests (Razorpay config placeholder, /order 503, Apple invalid token→401, /auth/session bogus id→401, /me accepts fake session_token seeded in user_sessions, /me rejects expired session, /me rejects unknown bearer). All prior flows (login/register/me/catalog/orders/addresses/prescriptions) still green; POST /api/orders still does not leak _id or user_id. Frontend (web preview @ 390x844): AuthScreen shows CapsulePill logo + 'Welcome back 👋' + segmented Log in/Sign up + 'MEDICINES CLOSER TO YOU' tag + Google button + disabled Apple pill (Platform.OS==='web'). Demo login → home → add-to-cart → cart → checkout renders both payment rows (COD selected, 'Online payment (setup pending)' disabled because config.ready=false). Placing order (COD) hits /api/orders, closes cart, returns to home. Tab nav to Account works, logout returns to AuthScreen.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' (RN Web 0.19+). References: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:83 (authCard) and :96 (authPrimary) — both use shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius. Cosmetic on web; harmless on iOS/Android but should be migrated to boxShadow for web parity.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Migrate shadow* style props in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (authCard L83, authPrimary L96) to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warning.

(Optional) When enabling Razorpay in production, remember the current guard: rzp_client is initialised at import time (server.py:41). Any change to RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET at runtime needs a backend restart. Consider re-checking env inside razorpay_config and razorpay_create_order so keys can be hot-rotated.
(Optional) Add a response_model to POST /api/orders (e.g. an OrderOut Pydantic model) to enforce _id exclusion at the framework layer, so future changes cannot re-introduce the ObjectId leak.
critical_code_review_comments: current_user (server.py:123-147) correctly accepts BOTH JWT and session_token from user_sessions, timezone-normalises expires_at, and 401s on missing/expired — verified with seeded fixture.
razorpay_config (server.py:477) returns key_id='' while placeholder, matching frontend expectations. razorpay_create_order (server.py:482) raises 503 when rzp_client is None — clean.
apple_signin (server.py:300) returns 401 for any jwt.PyJWTError and 500 only when APPLE_AUDIENCES is unset — currently configured, so invalid tokens correctly 401. Good.
exchange_emergent_session (server.py:353) 401s on upstream non-200, and 502 only on network errors — validated with a bogus session_id (upstream 401 → API 401).
index.tsx is now ~1150 lines — consider splitting AuthScreen, CartModal, AccountScreen etc into separate files for maintainability.
